# NoteBill

> NoteBill is AI-assisted invoicing software that turns rough job notes into clean, itemized invoices for freelancers, contractors, and service businesses.

NoteBill turns incomplete, messy invoice notes into a professional invoice. It structures free-form input, asks focused follow-up questions when pricing is missing instead of making silent assumptions, supports wording changes, saves invoice documents, and produces a clean print/PDF-ready result.
